verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a travel and expense SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Navan. The material describes only Navan-hosted services, such as the hosted MCP server and a production-only API base URL, so there is nothing to credit.
